svg.desc: Full editable reconstruction of a Text-to-SQL workflow figure. Base frames: top user question, left workflow environment containing database/documents/codebase panels, language-model box, and SQL output box. Contents include system/app/database icons, table schemas, document/codebase lists, arrows and feedback loops.

g.desc: Origin is the left edge of the user request; text runs rightward inside the rounded question frame.
g.text: Q: I need a daily report on key sales activities—covering tasks completed,
events held, leads generated, and the status of opportunities.

g.desc: Database panel contains labels on left, two rows of data-system and real-app icons across the top/middle, and complex schema tables at the bottom. Symmetry basis is vertical grouping: labels left, representative sources center/right, schema tables bottom.
Documents panel has small document/database/query icons in a left column and four labels aligned on the right; content is vertically equipartitioned.
Codebase panel is below documents; the underlined Codebase title sits outside the inner frame, with two columns of folders/files and a database file row. Symmetry basis is two-column list alignment.
Language model box contains robot icon at left and bold label to the right, centered vertically.
Two curved arrows connect the SQL box back toward the workflow environment: green upper arrow labeled SQLs/Python and orange lower arrow labeled Exec feedback.
SQL output frame contains syntax-colored generated SQL. The code starts at upper left and continues downward with centered ellipsis and omitted-lines note.
